brief_narrative:
Atlas Logistics wants to design and pilot a digital freight-matching platform for small shippers in Iberia.

The work runs six months, including a pilot with real customers. The stakeholders are the CEO, CTO and Head of Sales. Success means 200 shippers active on the pilot.
